newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia to approve mining COWS soon - official.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia to approve mining COWS soon - official.

text.p: The Indonesian government will soon approve 68 outstanding contracts of work (COWS) for the mining industry, a senior official of the Mines and Energy Ministry said on Tuesday.
"The applications for 68 outstanding COWS will be approved soon," Kuntoro Mangkusubroto, director general of mining at the Mines and Energy Ministry, told a Jakarta news conference.
He said the approval of the COWS had nothing to do with an application by Bre-X Minerals Ltd for COWS to develop the Busang gold find.
Approval of the 68 COWS had been expected last year.
Kuntoro said Bre-X and its partners in Busang had submitted applications for COWS covering the Busang II and Busang III areas and asked for them to be processed.
